# `plc.set_profile`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/plc.set_profile.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`plc.set_profile` (`SetProfile`, doc 10 §3.9 `plc.set_profile{cfg, profile}`, FR-PLC-008, FR-PLC-007; WP-S1.21
D8): pins another shipped address profile on a configuration project.

`profile` names a profile this build ships, by its reference `id@version` or its ID alone, without regard to case
(`iec-61131-3` pins `iec-61131-3@2027.1`); every other text is rejected at `/profile` with the list of shipped
profiles. The change renders only: addresses are stored canonically, so the project files differ in the one
`profile` member, and every address prints in the new notation (`Q0.1` → `%QX0.1`). A profile equal to the current
one writes nothing. The configuration project exists (`CmdError::NotFound`). One undo step. Outcome: the
configuration project.

## Types

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).
